title: Monitoring itself
description: Is the monitoring telling the truth, what does it cost, and what hardware is in the fleet.

panels.title: Series
panels.description: More series means more of the head's memory.

panels.title: Sparks known to discovery
panels.description: A new Spark is found by mDNS within a minute. `needs_ssh_key` means this head cannot log in yet: run ssh-copy-id, and enrolment finishes by itself. A Spark that dies stays here as `down`.

targets.expr: max by (member, hostname, address, member_role, state) (spark_fleet_member)

panels.title: Collectors
panels.description: A failing collector means its panels are empty, which does not mean zero.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: In cores. Monitoring must stay small next to the model.

panels.title: Rule failures
panels.description: Flat at zero. A rule that errors is otherwise silent.

targets.expr: max by (node, hostname, product, dgx_os, serial) (spark_node_info)
